what: Plug-tip pose relative to port 2 at the end of the approach (pre-insert), per episode, in sim with full DR. This is the start distribution Part 4 (insertion RL) must absorb.
frame_and_units: port-2 frame: x across the panel (m->mm), y up, z out of the panel (gap); rx, ry = rotation of the reader about port x / y (deg; tilt = |(rx, ry)|), roll about the port axis (deg). Signed mean/std and percentiles of |error|. gap_error = gap - stop distance.
how_measured: scripts/task/eval_approach.py (2 seeds x 512 worlds per configuration, GPU runtime): ZED RGB estimate of the PC pose (learned CNN on DR renders) -> left press hold (guarded, front half of the top) -> right arm IK move to 30 mm in front of the estimated port with the mean in-hand pose (true joints carry the encoder-offset error, the true reader the in-hand pose) -> visual servo on the right wrist RGB (learned plug-to-port CNN; r3_* nets trained with DAgger on in-loop states) with smooth moves and a Coulomb feed-forward; roll correction at the stop gap, last 2 iterations position only -> privileged measurement of the live plug-tip pose in the live port frame. Round 3 (r3_*) DR: PC +/-1.5 cm / +/-5 deg, PC feet mu U(0.8, 1.0), arm Coulomb x U(0.5, 1.3), gravity jitter, encoder offsets +/-1.5 deg (joints 2-5), latency 0-1 step, 55-deg grasp with the Part 1 measured in-hand poses (bootstrap of n = 2048 post-pick poses, results/usbc/policy/pick/), pad mu 1.2, impratio 30, policy/v1 visual DR (appearance, lighting, image noise, camera pose up to 2x real, intrinsics). Earlier rounds (no prefix / r2_*) used wider DR, provisional in-hand spreads and had a one-step command jerk at the teleport (fixed in round 3).
target: lateral <= 1 mm and tilt <= 2 deg at 99.5 %
samples_file: preinsert_error_samples.npz (recommended configuration, finite episodes: x, y, gap, rx, ry, roll)
